engine: Strata0.1.50 with isolated frontend ACL fix
phase: 17356-token input prefill in the64K GPU KV-growth diagnostic
counters: Four Windows Get-Counter samples at5second intervals
interpretation: E: reads cover the whole drive, not exclusively the model.
System Page Reads/sec and process PageFaultsPersec are different counters; process faults include soft faults.
Ordinary process IOReadBytesPersec does not account for all mapped-file paging.
Native logical expert-byte counters do not establish physical SSD bytes.
This short sample does not prove storage saturation or attribute every read to inference.
Different workloads, phases and desktop conditions prevent treating the Flint observation as a matched engine comparison.
